name: IRIS V3.2 Exact-3D Geometry Target Court V1
research_question: Does exact qualified 3D TSDF/sign/normal supervision outperform legacy F*-only geometry authority for watertight RealSaS puppet geometry while preserving source-view consistency?
hypothesis: Exact 3D sign and normal authority will reduce zero-surface displacement and hidden-region errors relative to F*-only training, while keeping F* as an auxiliary observation-consistency constraint prevents source-view regression.
